actionId.description: Action id bound to the External service request.

tenant.description: Tenant under which the External Service request is invoked.

tag.description: Tag under which the External Service request is invoked.

userId.description: Authenticated User id under which the External Service request is invoked.

authToken.description: c3auth token of authenticated user that can be used by External Service to call back into the C3 server.

title:
This type contains all the relevant C3 Server information passed to an external service {@link ExternalService} for
it to be able to fully identify the context under which it was invoked and also for it to be able to call back into
the C3 server.
name: ExternalServiceContext
